param.label: Species code
param.help: miRBase three-letter species prefix, e.g. hsa, mmu or dme. Only hairpins whose FASTA header contains this code are used.

validator.message: Use letters, digits, underscores or hyphens only

macros.token: #if $hairpin.is_of_type('fasta.gz') gunzip -c '$hairpin' > hairpin.fa && #else ln -s '$hairpin' hairpin.fa && #end if #if $gtf.is_of_type('gff3.gz') gunzip -c '$gtf' > annotation.gff3 && #else ln -s '$gtf' annotation.gff3 && #end if

param.label: Hairpin (precursor) sequences
param.help: For example miRBase hairpin.fa. These must be the same sequences the reads were aligned to.

param.label: Mature miRNA annotation
param.help: miRBase (or MirGeneDB) GFF3 with precursor and mature miRNA positions, e.g. hsa.gff3.
